row: Scramble streaming discovery: how streamed text really reaches the panel on the Deck. A MEASUREMENT, no code changed.
screen: Deck's own screen (eDP-1 enabled, DP-1 disabled); page reports screen 853x533 at 1.5; plugin column 300 CSS px; answer bubble 267 CSS px; answer text 12px
model: gemma4:e2b-it-qat (the Deck's only chat model), think on, ask_mode strategy, think effort medium

a_model_rhythm_over_ssh.how: scratchpad stream_rhythm.py piped over ssh: POST /api/chat stream=true, short Hollow Knight question (54 prompt tokens), every streamed line timed on the Deck
a_model_rhythm_over_ssh.reading: The model itself is even: a piece every 29 ms idle, every 50 ms with the game, never a gap over 83 ms.

b_panel_path_game_running.how: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor launched (deck_launchGame), bonsAI opened over it, question sent from the Ask button. Recorder 1 in SharedJSContext called get_background_game_ai_status every 150 ms (the panel's own cadence) and kept every change. Recorder 2 in the QAM page timed every animation frame and the live bubble's text length.
b_panel_path_game_running.question: What are good early weapon upgrades for the Driller in Deep Rock Galactic Survivor? Keep it to a short list.
b_panel_path_game_running.reading_delivery: New answer text reached the panel every 1.7-2.0 s in steps of about 100-125 characters, although the recorder asked 555 times at 150 ms. Cause (read from the code and one streamed line's size): the back end reads Ollama's stream with resp.read(4096), which waits for a full 4 KB; one streamed line is about 135 bytes, so a block is about 30 pieces, about 1.5-1.8 s with a game running.
b_panel_path_game_running.reading_frames: While the model runs with a game, the panel already drops well below 60 fps; the reveal moments are the worst. Scrambling must be measured against this, not against 60 fps.

cleanup: Both recorders stopped and removed from the page; game exited (deck_exitGame, then checked over ssh); keep-awake released. One question and answer was added to whichever chat was open on the Main tab.
